services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: We are located in downtown Cartersville, Georgia. If you are a school who can get to us, you’re welcome to attend! Homeschool groups are also welcome, but we ask that you form a group of at least 10 before reserving your ticket. We have found that homeschool co-ops will often accidentally double and triple book; this step will prevent that. We keep it simple: students and parent chaperones are $5 each. Any siblings who attend with a parent must also be included in the reservation and ticket count, and are also subject to the $5 fee. Teachers and school staff may attend at no cost.
